title: Rhetorical Duels and Classical Parliamentary Debate

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: The Reform Diets of Pozsony (Bratislava) were the main stage of political debate in the Reform Era (1825-1848). Count István Széchenyi stood for patient economic modernization (*szerves fejlődés*), while Lajos Kossuth argued for political freedom and for uniting the interests of nobles and the rest of the nation (*érdekegyesítés*).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: A typical opening formula of a parliamentary speech (an example in the style of the period, not a quotation): *Tisztelt Ház! Nem térhetünk ki a történelmi felelősség elől...*
